definitions.volatility1h: Production option: mean((high-low)/close) of the last 3 completed native 1H candles; 3h lookback. This existing rule is unchanged.
definitions.change1h5m: Production option: sum(abs(close/previousClose-1)) / 12 over 13 completed 5m closes; exactly twelve 5m distances in one hour.

plan.classification: Two causal fixed-universe historical model replays. All own Base/config/range/direction gates remain active; retain losses, infeasibility, empty cohorts and failures. Not live execution or unseen performance.

selections.definition: Production option: mean((high-low)/close) of the last 3 completed native 1H candles; 3h lookback. This existing rule is unchanged.
selections.liquidityBasis: Causal preceding 24h sum of native minute close * base volume (OHLCV quote-volume approximation), never the feed's future endpoint ticker.
selections.selectionPolicy: Choose once at trade start; hold the same twelve-symbol universe for the twelve-hour run. Historical ranking among the same cached 24 contracts, not an exchange-wide listing survey.

selections.definition: Production option: sum(abs(close/previousClose-1)) / 12 over 13 completed 5m closes; exactly twelve 5m distances in one hour.
selections.liquidityBasis: Causal preceding 24h sum of native minute close * base volume (OHLCV quote-volume approximation), never the feed's future endpoint ticker.
selections.selectionPolicy: Choose once at trade start; hold the same twelve-symbol universe for the twelve-hour run. Historical ranking among the same cached 24 contracts, not an exchange-wide listing survey.

orderDiagnostic.policy: Production compareTapeTrades preserves ranked universe source order for equal exit/entry timestamps. symbol-directions and signal-gates regressions explicitly retain this policy. Canonical sorting here is a post-hoc diagnostic only; neither saved execution nor historical gate sample is altered. Shared source rows and returns match; ordering can change Last-N boundary membership and chronological drawdown.

comparison.basis: Funded settled exact identity multiset; duplicate legs retained; verified unit returns compared without charging costs again

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close

every step processes every range with tapes (validated ≤ tapes, taken ≤ candidates)

heatmap: every executed cell is a computed cell
coverage: every combo evaluated at Base (engine + signal + independent Exit)
coverage: every indication kind evaluated

coverage: range sh active tapes match kept sets
coverage: range gn active tapes match kept sets
config sets: every grid cell accounted (built + not built = grid)
config sets: every built config kept or dropped for too few closes
execution: strategy type normal output has config tapes
execution: strategy type trailing output has config tapes
execution: range mc output matches accepted entries
execution: range mn output matches accepted entries
execution: range sh output matches accepted entries
execution: range gn output matches accepted entries
memory: the reported compute ran at the full level (no memory fallback)
hour × type: funded type columns add up to funded orders closed, every hour
hour × type: type columns add up to virtual closes, every hour

modelNotes: Base range rows are pair-level representative evidence, not counts or PF of every configured TP/SL cell.
Validation PF pools only configs passing their own recorded configEval. Seated PF uses that step's actual Real IDs too.
Historical validation windows overlap across steps and configurations; never sum them as distinct executed orders.
Execution contains only funded modeled settled closes after Base, own config validation, entry context and execution filters. It is not venue-owned execution.
The baseline all-config capital requirement is infeasible. This audit does not certify live sizing or profitability.
No-loss rows have no finite measured PF; the existing qualifying gate uses score 4. Empty/unknown cohorts remain unavailable.
